text.p: Chester Valley Bancorp Inc said on Thursday Edward Plank retired as chairman of the board, and it named Chief Executive Officer Ellen Ann Roberts as his successor.
Roberts would remain CEO, the company said, adding that all changes applied to its sole subsidiary First Financial Savings Bank PaSA. Plank had been chairman since 1987.
Anthony Biondi was elected president and would remain chief operating officer, the company said. Biondi had also been chief financial officer.
Christine Dullinger was elected CFO, it said. Dullinger was elected treasurer in 1994 and would keep the position.
Plank would remain a director of the company and the bank, and has been elected Chairman Emeritus.
